dogecoin.text:
The deepest regret I have in this industry is selling my Dogecoin in 2016 because I didn’t believe in an underlying thesis.

I’m still not sure what that thesis was, or what it is today, or whether anyone has or ever had any Dogecoin thesis...but still.
@fubuloubu Call it Dogehouse. Boom! $100bn Dogecoin, exchange is worth a few billion, we ring the NASDAQ opening bell in 2 years.
Quick someone put the EVM on Dogecoin and let’s turn this memeentum bull run into a bona fide Ethereum-Killer-Killer.
@prestonjbyrne I don’t hold any Dogecoin anymore but a part of me wants this to happen for the lulz
